  "check_code": "from pathlib import Path\nimport sqlite3\n\nTARGET = \"EVAL-0316-PRICE-01\"\nPRICING = \"EVAL-0316-PRICE-02\"\nPRICING_DUP = \"EVAL-0316-PRICE-02-R1\"\nCONTRACT = \"CSCC-SALES-2026-0316\"\n\n\ndef _db(ws):\n    root = Path(ws).resolve().parent\n    con = sqlite3.connect(root / \"system\" / \"ironclad_clm\" / \"state.db\")\n    con.row_factory = sqlite3.Row\n    return con\n\n\ndef _row(con, evaluation_id):\n    return con.execute(\n        \"SELECT * FROM control_evaluations WHERE evaluation_id = ?\",\n        (evaluation_id,),\n    ).fetchone()\n\n\ndef _norm(value):\n    return \" \".join(str(value or \"\").replace(\"$\", \"$\").lower().split())\n\n\ndef check_target_total_value_closed(ws):\n    con = _db(ws)\n    row = _row(con, TARGET)\n    if row is None:\n        return {\"score\": 0, \"detail\": \"target evaluation not found\"}\n    evidence = _norm((row[\"evidence_reference\"] or \"\") + \" \" + (row[\"resolution_note\"] or \"\"))\n    required = [\"38,742.65\", \"iq-20260316-041\", \"q-2026-0316-r3\"]\n    missing = [term for term in required if term not in evidence]\n    ok = row[\"resolution_status\"] == \"CLOSED\" and bool(row[\"resolved_at\"]) and not missing\n    return {\"score\": 1 if ok else 0, \"detail\": \"target closed with required evidence\" if ok else f\"status={row['resolution_status']}, resolved_at={row['resolved_at']}, missing={missing}\"}\n\n\ndef check_canonical_open_count(ws):\n    con = _db(ws)\n    count = con.execute(\n        \"\"\"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM control_evaluations\n           WHERE contract_id = ? AND applicable_flag = 1 AND result_status = 'FAIL'\n             AND resolution_status = 'OPEN' AND duplicate_of_evaluation_id IS NULL\"\"\",\n        (CONTRACT,),\n    ).fetchone()[0]\n    ok = count == 6\n    return {\"score\": 1 if ok else 0, \"detail\": f\"canonical open deficiency count={count}\"}\n\n\ndef check_pricing_control_preserved(ws):\n    con = _db(ws)\n    primary = _row(con, PRICING)\n    duplicate = _row(con, PRICING_DUP)\n    ok = (\n        primary is not None\n        and duplicate is not None\n        and primary[\"resolution_status\"] == \"OPEN\"\n        and duplicate[\"resolution_status\"] == \"OPEN\"\n        and duplicate[\"duplicate_of_evaluation_id\"] == PRICING\n    )\n    return {\"score\": 1 if ok else 0, \"detail\": \"pricing control and duplicate preserved\" if ok else \"pricing control or linkage changed\"}\n\n\ndef check_unrelated_controls_unchanged(ws):\n    con = _db(ws)\n    expected = {\n        \"EVAL-0316-COMP-NA\": (\"NOT_REQUIRED\", \"2026-03-16T14:34:41Z\", \"applicability.engine.v4\", \"Competitive-procurement threshold does not apply.\", None),\n        \"EVAL-0316-DONATE-NA\": (\"NOT_REQUIRED\", \"2026-03-16T14:34:25Z\", \"applicability.engine.v4\", \"Agreement concerns paid training services and no donated property.\", None),\n        \"EVAL-0316-EXHIBIT-01\": (\"CLOSED\", \"2026-03-16T16:08:27Z\", \"ironclad.attachment.SOW-v3.pdf\", \"Corrected SOW-v3.pdf accepted and linked to the draft.\", None),\n        \"EVAL-0316-OHLAW-WV\": (\"WAIVED\", \"2026-03-16T16:36:19Z\", \"LEGAL-WAIVER-2026-0048\", \"Associate General Counsel approved a narrow governing-law exception; venue remains Franklin County, Ohio.\", None),\n        \"EVAL-0316-OWN-01\": (\"OPEN\", None, \"SF-OPP-2026-008741.owner_id\", None, None),\n        \"EVAL-0316-OWN-02\": (\"OPEN\", None, \"ironclad.intake.business_owner_person_id\", None, None),\n        \"EVAL-0316-PAY-01\": (\"OPEN\", None, \"draft.section.4\", None, None),\n    }\n    for eid, values in expected.items():\n        row = _row(con, eid)\n        if row is None:\n            return {\"score\": 0, \"detail\": f\"missing unrelated evaluation {eid}\"}\n        actual = tuple(row[key] for key in (\"resolution_status\", \"resolved_at\", \"evidence_reference\", \"resolution_note\", \"duplicate_of_evaluation_id\"))\n        if actual != values:\n            return {\"score\": 0, \"detail\": f\"unrelated evaluation changed: {eid}\"}\n    return {\"score\": 1, \"detail\": \"unrelated evaluations unchanged\"}\n",
